stories.title: Your #NASAMoonCrew for Artemis II!
stories.summary: Ahead of the Artemis II mission NASA wants to know: who is in YOUR #NASAMoonCrew? Share your photos, art, videos—anything depicting your crew—with the world! This gallery includes a variety of submissions received throughout the campaign. During Artemis II, over the course of about ten days, four astronauts will travel approximately 685,000 miles from Earth, venture around the Moon, and return home. The flight will—for the first time with astronauts—test NASA’s human deep space exploration capabilities, including the agency’s Exploration Ground Systems, SLS (Space Launch System) rocket, and Orion spacecraft. The post Your #NASAMoonCrew for Artemis II! appeared first on NASA Science.
